comment: Nuxel physical pointer document (USB HID mouse / touchpad). Installed to /etc/nuxel/input/input.json. Read by libnuxel-libinput-path.so (direct libinput device settings) and by nuxel-input-apply.sh (the same values through org.gnome.desktop.peripherals GSettings, which phoc consumes live). Keyboard layout and key repeat remain in /etc/nuxel/keyboard/keyboard.json because they are compositor/XKB settings, not libinput settings.
consumer: libnuxel-libinput-path.so (libinput accel/scroll/tap/dwt) + nuxel-input-apply.sh -> GSettings -> phoc mouse/touchpad handlers
probe: input-state (launcher host status.read -> /run/nuxel-input.state, written by the shim) and input-gsettings-state (/run/nuxel-input-gsettings.state, written by the applier)
